facts.text: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny brings back lunch for Pappas.
facts.why: I could not find a meatball sub or a lunch run for Pappas in any source I opened. The film does have Johnny and Pappas on a bank stakeout, and Johnny reporting that Bodhi ate lunch at Patrick's Roadhouse. The printed cue and data cue match.
facts.fix: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny and Pappas start the bank stakeout.

facts.why: Depends on the cue. No source I opened shows Utah and a meatball sub.
